 Herro told reporters he has communicated with Adebayo
 By
 Chantz Martin Fox News

 The Miami Heat welcomed the Milwaukee Bucks on Wednesday night in a matchup that might otherwise blend into the early-season NBA schedule.
 But a summer feud involving a former Heat player and one of Miami’s current stars has added an unexpected layer of intrigue to the matchup. In July, tensions between Bam Adebayo and Tyler Herro reportedly boiled over in Las Vegas.

 Since the dispute between the two NBA stars, questions have lingered over whether Bam Adebayo and Tyler Herro had repaired their relationship or whether tensions remained.
 CLICK HERE FOR MORE OUTKICK SPORTS COVERAGE 
 Bam Adebayo and Tyler Herro of the Miami Heat exit the court during a delay in a game against the Chicago Bulls at the United Center in Chicago, Illinois, on Jan. 8, 2026. (Melissa Tamez/Icon Sportswire via Getty Images) 
 Wednesday marked the first time the two players faced each other since the incident, and Herro was noncommittal when asked about the state of their relationship.
 HEAT VS. BUCKS BEST BETS: GIANNIS GETS HIS FIRST SHOT AT MILWAUKEE 
 "I'm not sure. I haven't talked to him," Herro told reporters Wednesday.
 Adebayo and Herro were involved in a physical altercation at an NBA Summer League practice facility, during which the Heat center allegedly struck the Milwaukee Bucks guard in the head area.
 A blockbuster deal over this past offseason sent Giannis Antetokounmpo to Miami and Herro to Milwaukee, ending his time as Adebayo’s Heat teammate.
 Bam Adebayo and Tyler Herro react during the fourth quarter against the Atlanta Hawks at Kaseya Center on March 27, 2025, in Miami, Florida. (Getty Images) 
 MIAMI HEAT UNVEIL VICE CITY COURT FOR 'GRAND THEFT AUTO VI'-THEMED CLASH WITH MILWAUKEE BUCKS 
 Herro reflected on his time sharing a locker room with Adebayo, and praised the three-time All-Star's skillset. "Obviously I spent a lot of time with Bam. I admire his game. He's a great player. Can do everything on the floor, guard 1-5. He's gifted offensively."
 Sources told ESPN that Adebayo initially confronted Herro over alleged social media comments criticizing his defense. Screenshots circulated online purportedly showed Herro questioning Adebayo’s defensive prowess in an Instagram direct message with a fan.
 Milwaukee Bucks guard Tyler Herro drives against Atlanta Hawks guard RayJ Dennis in the first half at Fiserv Forum in Milwaukee, Wis., on Nov. 15, 2026. (IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect) 
 CLICK HERE TO DOWNLOAD THE FOX NEWS APP 
 Adebayo agreed to a three-year , $166 million extension with Miami in June 2024. The alleged DM also appeared to question whether his nightly defensive effort justified a salary approaching $60 million.
 Miami entered Wednesday night with an 8-6 record, while Milwaukee had won just once this season.
 Chantz Martin is a sports writer for Fox News Digital.
